test_title: PYST 229: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 13th Nov, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre of the table. R is to the immediate left of M, who is second to the left of P. K is at fourth place to the right of P. Q is between L and N. R is second to the right of L. Who is sitting between M and P?
solution:
**Given : K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre of the table. **

**Explanation :**

NOTE → As all of them are facing the center with their backs, therefore with respect to their sitting position i.e backwards, all of them will be facing outside.

1) R is to the immediate left of M, who is second to the left of P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0cf194f673d1ad5c10984384f7e18ae6591cb766ee05c95120200db6aee51fa.png] 

2) K is at fourth place to the right of P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/455245014cc858596bdbd19f2676d79ae41adfa330662afbd17fac568e750ae2.png] 

3) R is second to the right of L. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/70503ecb3ab46512a9db55fc540f32025df9f179d05cdc02dc2ff6cad495f520.png] 

4) Q is between L and N. 

As after positioning Q and N only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2e3137c1d85dcf75cf288701176408608aa85466506bed2fe90ec8441eb4e9ea.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement O is sitting between M and P.

Hence, **"O"** is the correct answer.
